title: Synthesis Through Simulation: Generating Coherent Enterprise Data via Scalable Agent-System Interaction
abstract: arXiv:2610.10549v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tool-calling agents have become central to enterprise AI, yet training and evaluating them at scale remains severely constrained due to business and legal restrictions on enterprise systems, data, and database schemas. Tabular data synthesis offers a natural alternative, but its effectiveness is fundamentally limited by structural validity and schema availability, while procedure-based approaches yield the opposite weakness, typically lacking distributional fidelity without per-domain authoring. We introduce **Synthesis Through Simulation** (STS), a **schema--free** data synthesis paradigm in which an LLM agent generates data by executing operations against policy-enforcing APIs within simulated enterprise environments. translated_title: 基于仿真的合成：通过可扩展的智能体-系统交互生成连贯的企业数据
translated_abstract: 工具调用智能体已成为企业人工智能的核心，但由于商业和法律对企业系统、数据及数据库模式的限制，大规模训练和评估这类智能体仍受到严重制约。表格数据合成提供了一种自然的替代方案，但其有效性从根本上受限于结构有效性和模式可用性；而基于过程的方法则存在相反的弱点——在缺乏针对特定领域的专门编写时，通常难以保证分布保真度。我们提出了“通过仿真进行合成”（Synthesis Through Simulation, STS），这是一种无模式（schema-free）的数据合成范式，其中大语言模型智能体通过在模拟的企业环境中调用执行策略约束的API来进行操作，从而生成数据。由于数据是通过定义何为有效的同一环境生成的，STS在构造上保证了结构有效性，同时将有效性约束与分布建模解耦，使两者各自……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了“通过仿真进行合成”（STS）这一无模式数据合成范式，让LLM智能体在模拟企业环境中通过调用策略约束的API生成数据，从构造上保证结构有效性，突破了企业智能体训练与评估数据受限的瓶颈。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Synthesis Through Simulation (STS), a schema-free data synthesis paradigm in which an LLM agent generates coherent enterprise data by executing operations against policy-enforcing APIs within simulated enterprise environments, guaranteeing structural validity by construction.
